# Metallic Labyrinth — one-file iPad download

Tilt your iPad to roll a chrome ball to the green cup. Red pits sit beside the goal.

## Download this file

**[MetallicLabyrinth.codea.zip](MetallicLabyrinth.codea.zip)**

That is the only file you need.

## Open on iPad (no PC)

1. On the iPad, download `MetallicLabyrinth.codea.zip` (Safari → tap the zip on GitHub).
2. Open **Files**, tap the zip so it unzips.
3. Copy the `MetallicLabyrinth.codea` folder into **On My iPad → Codea**.
4. Open **Codea** → tap **MetallicLabyrinth** → **Play**.
5. Hold the iPad almost flat, then tilt to roll.

Codea must already be installed from the App Store. Apple does not let a zip auto-launch the game; dropping the `.codea` folder into Codea’s folder is the one-file install.

## Paste fallback (still one file)

If Files will not copy the folder, download [MetallicLabyrinth.lua](MetallicLabyrinth.lua), copy all of it, make a new Codea project, replace **Main**, tap Play.

## Controls

| Input | Action |
|--------|--------|
| Tilt iPad | Roll the ball |
| Drag finger | Push assist when the iPad is flat |
| Tap after win | Next maze |
| Tap after lives gone | Retry |
